department: Department of Chemistry, Physics, and Atmospheric Sciences

deadline.value: Fall admission deadline for the Ph.D. in Chemistry & Biochemistry is March 1, 2027 (matching the March 1 Graduate Assistantship and Tuition-waiver deadline).
deadline.quote: Fall Admission: March 1 | Ph.D. in Chemistry & Biochemistry

also.quote: The deadline for submitting applications is March 1.

gre_general.value: Applicants may submit GRE scores or take the Chemistry Department's entrance exam instead (note the Courseleaf catalog lists 'GRE Score' without noting the entrance-exam option).
gre_general.quote: GRE Score* | (*Students may take the Department’s entrance exam instead of the GRE)

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for Chemistry (discontinued in May 2023); ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Neither the Chemistry graduate requirements page nor the graduate catalog states whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Teaching Assistant and Research Assistant positions (>= $12,000/year + tuition) are open to first-time graduate students; PhD students must teach as a TA for 2-4 semesters, and university assistantships/tuition waivers require a separate March 1 application (federal LS-MAMP, PREM, RISE, Title III, and agency fellowships on the page are restricted to U.S. citizens/permanent residents).
funding.quote: Teaching Assistant | Who should apply: First Time Graduate Students (≥ $12,000/year + Tuition) | Research Assistant | Who should apply: First Time Graduate Students (≥ $12,000/year + Tuition)

also.quote: The Division of Graduate Studies awards assistantships each year with a monthly stipend plus tuition for one academic year: Fall and Spring... The deadline for submitting applications is March 1.

entry_route.value: Applicants enter with a B.S. in chemistry or a closely related field (grades of 'C' or better in core chemistry lab courses); entrants with an M.S. in chemistry may transfer up to 12 lecture credits.
entry_route.quote: applicants must have a B.S. degree in chemistry or a closely related field with passing grades ‘C’ or better for the following courses with labs:

also.quote: Students Entering the Ph.D. Program With a M.S. Degree in Chemistry

notes: 60-credit Ph.D. in Chemistry (18 lecture credits, 2 seminar credits, 40 dissertation research credits).
